== Description ==

SWCCG World Championship trophy case at the Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, from ''Star Wars Insider'' #43 p. 65.

== Source and credit ==

Source: Ryan Morris, "The Thrill of Victory", ''Star Wars Insider'' #43, p. 65. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/starwarsinsider_1_to_153_plus_specials Star Wars Insider Magazines (1 to 153 + Specials)], Internet Archive (jp2 leaf 0064).

Identification: printed title •SWCCG World Championship Trophy Case.
